source_title: World / Oct 29, 2026 Steven Spielberg pulls $29.9 M LA ranch off the market
source_excerpt: Filmmaker Steven Spielberg has pulled his Los Angeles ranch off the market after listing it for $29.9 million last month, Realtor.com reported. For nearly 27 years, Steven Spielberg, 79, and Kate Capshaw, 72, held a 2.8-acre property in Sullivan Canyon, Los Angeles, though they never lived there. The land was for the horses, and the coupleâs plans for it were far bigger than a stable and a paddock.They bought the ranch in 1999Spielberg and his wife bought the estate in 1999 for $5.75 million. They wanted to incorporate a five-storey riding facility, a guesthouse and a three-storey guardhouse, with a renovation budget of more than $7 million. Few homeowners in Los Angeles would take on a project like that, and fewer would attempt it in a residential canyon. Not everyone was happy with the scale of the plan. It now features a 20,000-square-foot riding arena. The main house, known as Dogwood, has seven bedrooms and 9.5 bathrooms. The property offers an impressive array of equestrian amenities alongside its luxurious living spaces.
